title: Enforcer Shield
summary: An unobtainable shield that can boost a nonlethal attack after a miss against you.

fields.Armour Class: +2 AC while equipped with Shield proficiency.
fields.Staunch Blessing: When a creature misses you, add 1d4 to your next attack roll that deals nonlethal damage. Dealing lethal damage removes the bonus.
fields.Availability: Unobtainable in normal play. Dammon’s recorded stock quantity is zero.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
